{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print("Unique sites found:", unique_sites)

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
print("Number of patients with multiple rows:", len(duplicates))
print("Patients with multiple rows:", duplicates.index.tolist())

# Check the highest sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print("Max sample_seq per patient:", max_sample_seq_per_patient.head())

# Confirm the sentinel value -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch
print("Unique assay_batch:", df['assay_batch'].unique())"}
